summary: Four related changes in one session: (1) Connected Papers-style knowledge graph refinement — one node per paper, compact author/title-year labels, category hue with year-based lightness (newer darker), bounded radial first view centered on the selected paper, thin solid similarity/category edges, paper-first sidebar focus, and readable zoom/focus behavior. (2) Migration stdout purity fix — apply_migrations() printed progress to stdout, breaking the organization worker JSON IPC contract on first runs; output rerouted to stderr via _log(); three regression tests added. (3) Server data-path fix — /api/user_settings and /api/cache now respect the resolved data_dir() path and PAPERDIGHELPER_DATA. (4) UI visual redesign — index.html and settings.html rebuilt with unified CSS tokens, dark mode, accent variants, and SVG icons. AGENTS.md dev loop updated with desktop build step.

budget_impact.rationale: Pure UI, IPC correctness, and path-fix changes. No model calls introduced or modified. No gateway operations added. No prompt, ceiling, or operation registry change.
budget_impact.before: Graph labels and layout were difficult to read on entry; nodes could be scattered or clipped, color did not clearly communicate category/year, and the sidebar did not focus the graph paper-first. Migration progress printed to stdout, breaking the worker JSON IPC on first runs. Settings/cache paths could ignore PAPERDIGHELPER_DATA.
budget_impact.after: Graph opens with a bounded radial paper layout centered on the selected origin, compact readable labels, category hue plus year lightness, solid weighted edges, and direct paper/category focus. Migration diagnostics go to stderr only. Settings/cache use resolved data_dir().

checks.note: 199 Python tests pass; focused Node UI/motion run in the same evidence passes 35 tests.

reviews.reviewer: Implementing agent; reviewed diff, failure paths, IPC contract, data-path correctness, and budget impact

open_risks: Graph relation quality and visual density on a larger, mixed-year corpus remain unmeasured; current category edges are explicitly non-citation hints.
data_dir() calls make_app() on every settings request — cheap but adds a call; acceptable for a low-frequency endpoint.
Seed-star shape on graph nodes (papers matching harness/seeds.json) deferred; noted in assumptions.
18 HTTP smoke tests remain blocked by sandbox port binding; pre-existing, not introduced by this change.
